title: 第17章 空间之力第18章 丰厚的奖励
content_zh:
“我也不知道可能是因为灵宝的原因吧！”玄水的问题让杨修也很懵。
“虽然玄水重剑的剑身已经认可了你但是你还要经过我的考验！”玄水不纠结杨修身上的秘密了，向杨修发起了考验。
杨修挥散了思绪与玄水对立开口道“你说吧要怎么考验？”
玄水翻手玄水重剑出现在她的手上，随后剑指杨修“很简单击败我证明你有资格使用玄水重剑！”
“好！”杨修翻手唤出龙血剑，赤也在杨修唤出龙血剑的一瞬间出现目光死死盯着玄水。
杨修并未先出剑只是持剑而立等玄水进攻，他知道玄水几乎没什么实战经验这么做也算是让玄水弥补自己经验方面的优势。
“当心！”玄水持剑冲向杨修没有任何花哨只是简单的劈砍而来。
杨修挥剑格挡，龙血剑与玄水重剑碰撞，虽然玄水的进攻被杨修抵挡了下来，但是杨修发麻的虎口证明玄水重剑朴实的攻击依旧非常强大，杨修将龙血剑握的更紧目光盯着玄水。
玄水知道刚刚那一击虽然两人都没奈何对方，但是自己那一击隐隐占了上风，心中的信心大增手持玄水重剑向杨修刺去。
杨修经过刚才一击知道玄水不能用相同的剑招应对，既然硬刚不行那就以柔克刚，右手挥剑攻击打在玄水剑身上，将玄水攻击偏转卸去玄水的力道，杨修眼中带着笑意，心里在想，这玄水的攻击如同孩童一般没有什么经验。
玄水看到杨修的笑意，心里不免生出了恼怒的情绪准备用力将落空的剑横斩向杨修，但是还没等她出手只见杨修左手抓住她卧剑的手腕，而杨修的右手反手持剑将龙血剑抵住了她的脖颈儿，两人就这样僵持了一会儿，主要是玄水眼神中非常不服气，而杨修也不急就满脸笑意的看着她。
“呼！我输了”终于玄水忍不住开口道，但是眼神中还是带着不甘心。
杨修听到玄水认输嘴角又上扬一分，开口道“要不要再试试？”
听到杨修的话玄水脸上先是出现笑意随后又想到什么，笑容消失淡淡道“不用了！你经验比我多，我大概是不如你！”
杨修闻言也没有多说挥了挥手，将玄水失去战斗意识掉落的玄水重剑以御剑术卧入手中，重剑入手意料之中的重，除了重之外还有一种冰凉感，是那种舒服的冰凉并不冷，杨修近距离仔仔细细又打量了一遍玄水重剑，玄水重剑的剑身上也有纹路，与龙血剑不同的是玄水重剑剑身的纹路非常的工整，左右剑身非常对称。
杨修很满意玄水重剑抬头准备跟玄水聊什么的时候才发现他已经从意识空间出来了而玄水已经消失了，在他的右手之上原本龙血剑纹的旁边又多出了一些纹路。
杨修无奈叹了口气，看来是有点打击到她了，没关系以后相处时间还长，慢慢来吧，挥手将剑收回储物戒中，步伐继续向前走。
杨修从秘境出来之后走的全是山路，没有再出现什么空间裂隙和门关什么的，他心里充满了疑惑，“难道考验就到这了？”
就在他疑惑的时候山路的路径蔓延到了一个山洞内，杨修望着黑漆漆的山洞考虑要不要进去。
“进来！快进来！”就在杨修思索的时候一道声音从脑海中响起，然后在杨修充满惊讶的目光下他的身体竟然不由自主动了起来这让他生出了恐慌的情绪，伴随着身体移山洞周围的火把也一道道亮起将洞内的情况照亮，最终杨修在一面石壁前停了下来，石壁上刻画着杨修看不懂文字。

“咚！”一道声响从杨修身后响起，杨修转身看去发现来路已经被另一道石壁封住，随后杨修有察觉到自己可以掌控身体了，暗暗松了一口气，被莫名其妙控制住身体真的非常让人不安。
“看来类似于一个解密的密室！”杨修嘴里嘟哝着，四下打量起这山洞的四周最后将目光再次落到石壁之上，只是这次让杨修惊讶了，刚刚他还看不懂的文字他居然都能读懂了，不是他能看懂原来的文字而是这些文字自己变成了他能读懂的文字。
只见石壁上写到“恭喜你少年郎！你走到这里说明你已经过了前两关，怎么样感觉还不错吧！你距离登顶只差最后一步了喔！顿悟吧！”
当杨修看完最后一个字，石壁上的文字化为光芒在杨修身前凝聚最后变成了一颗紫色的宝珠，杨修伸手抓住一股巨大能量从中传出，杨修凝神用灵识开始感受这颗宝珠，就在他灵识触碰了宝珠一下，杨修赶忙收回灵识，刚才从灵识探查的反馈来讲这是一颗空间宝珠，杨修不免震惊。
在无垠大陆除了灵宝传说之外还有一种就是掌握元素力量的元素修士们，这些修士虽然名气不如凝聚灵宝的修士，但是从实力来讲元素修士们的实力也不是一般修士可以比拟的。
一般来讲元素修士们的灵气都相对于亲和某种元素，这也让元素修士们在自己亲和的元素之地修炼速度会有提升，另一方面如果元素修士对某种元素掌控过于强大可以施展出领域改变战场，身处于自己创造的领域之中元素修士不只攻击力会大幅度提升，就连灵气恢复速度也会翻倍，这也是元素修士比一般修士强大的原因。
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
“这是要我感悟空间之力吗？”杨修吞咽了下口水，茫然的看着手中的空间宝珠陷入了沉思，如果这宝珠是剑法之类的话他可能会有信心但是这是一枚元素类宝珠而且还是元素类稀有的空间系宝珠，他不觉得自己有这个实力，但是刚刚石壁的话给他感觉就是没办法顿悟自己就很难出去了，杨修望着宝珠陷入了思索。
“砰！”正在杨修思索之际，杨修的灵宝从意识空间出来在杨修错愕的目光下，形似青玉剑胚的灵宝一剑刺入杨修手中宝珠之中，顿时宝珠内的空间灵气外泄，四周的空间开始晃动扭曲。
“啪！”在杨修观察四周的时候杨修手中的空间宝珠彻底碎裂，而杨修四周的空间逐渐稳定下来，原本的山洞消失了，四周全是灰蒙蒙的，杨修往脚下看去脚下也是灰蒙蒙的就好像他踩在高空中的云上一般。
“嗡嗡嗡！”灵宝漂浮在杨修身前，杨修看向灵宝，原本青玉剑胚现在变了颜色从青色变成了青紫交融的颜色。
“这是吸收了空间灵气？”杨修疑惑的看着灵宝，灵宝本身就是丹田灵气凝聚之物，自己自从凝聚灵宝之后灵气储存的地方也从储存到丹田中变成了储存到灵宝中，可以说现在灵宝就是他的丹田。
“难道可以使用空间之力了？”杨修想着伸手抓住灵宝一股，从中抽取灵气果然一股空间灵气被从中抽出在杨修手中凝聚随他意念一动，空间灵气被消耗一道微小的空间裂隙出现，不过只持续了不到一秒便消失了，杨修大喜，自己居然可以使用空间之力了。
“难道这也是灵宝的特性之一可以吸收元素之力？那这样灵宝真的是太厉害了！”杨修还在思索着，这时一道空间裂隙从他的身后浮现一道剑气从中斩出。

content_en:
"I don't know, maybe it's because of the Lingbao!" Yang Xiu was also confused by Xuan Shui's question.
"Although the sword body of Xuanshui's heavy sword has recognized you, you still have to pass my test!" Xuanshui stopped worrying about Yang Xiu's secrets and launched a test to Yang Xiu.
Yang Xiu dismissed his thoughts and confronted Xuan Shui and said, "Tell me how the test will be?"
Xuanshui turned her hand and the Xuanshui Heavy Sword appeared in her hand, and then pointed the sword at Yang Xiu. "It's easy to defeat me to prove that you are qualified to use the Xuanshui Heavy Sword!"
"Okay!" Yang Xiu turned over his hand and summoned the Dragon Blood Sword. Chi also appeared and stared at Xuanshui the moment Yang Xiu summoned the Dragon Blood Sword.
Yang Xiu didn't draw his sword first but just stood there waiting for Xuanshui to attack. He knew that Xuanshui had almost no actual combat experience, so doing so allowed Xuanshui to make up for his experience advantage.
"Be careful!" Xuan Shui rushed towards Yang Xiu with his sword, just a simple slash without any fancy tricks.
Yang Xiu waved his sword to block, and the Dragon Blood Sword collided with the Xuanshui Heavy Sword. Although Xuanshui's attack was blocked by Yang Xiu, Yang Xiu's numb mouth proved that the simple attack of the Xuanshui Heavy Sword was still very powerful. Yang Xiu held the Dragon Blood Sword tighter and stared at Xuanshui.
Xuan Shui knew that even though neither of them could do anything to the other in the attack just now, his own attack had the upper hand. He felt confident in his heart and stabbed Yang Xiu with Xuan Shui's heavy sword.
After the previous attack, Yang Xiu knew that Xuanshui could not respond with the same sword move. Since hardness was not enough, he used softness to overcome the strength. He swung the sword attack with his right hand and hit Xuanshui's sword, deflecting Xuanshui's attack and taking away Xuanshui's power. Yang Xiu had a smile in his eyes, thinking in his heart that Xuanshui's attack was as inexperienced as a child's.
When Xuan Shui saw Yang Xiu's smile, he couldn't help but feel angry in his heart. He was about to slash the failed sword horizontally at Yang Xiu, but before she could take action, he saw Yang Xiu's left hand grabbing her wrist where the sword was lying.
"Phew! I lost," Xuan Shui finally couldn't help but said, but there was still unwillingness in his eyes.
When Yang Xiu heard Xuan Shui admitting defeat, the corner of his mouth rose again and he said, "Do you want to try again?"
Hearing Yang Xiu's words, Xuan Shui first smiled and then thought of something. The smile disappeared and he said lightly, "No need! You have more experience than me. I'm probably not as good as you!"
Hearing this, Yang Xiu waved his hand without saying anything, and put the Xuanshui Heavy Sword, which Xuanshui had lost his fighting consciousness, into his hand with sword control skills. The heavy sword was unexpectedly heavy, and it also had a cold feeling. It was the kind of comfortable coldness that was not cold. Yang Xiu looked at the Xuanshui Heavy Sword carefully at close range.
Yang Xiu was very satisfied with Xuanshui's heavy sword and raised his head to talk to Xuanshui. Only when he realized that he had come out of the consciousness space and Xuanshui had disappeared, there were some more lines on his right hand next to the original dragon blood sword pattern.
Yang Xiu sighed helplessly. It seemed that it was a bit of a shock to her. It didn't matter that we would spend more time together in the future. Let's take our time. He waved his sword and put it back into the storage ring and continued to move forward.
After Yang Xiu came out of the secret realm, he walked all the way up the mountain. There were no space cracks or doors. He was full of doubts, "Is this the end of the test?"
Just when he was confused, the path of the mountain road spread into a cave. Yang Xiu looked at the dark cave and considered whether to go in.
"Come in! Come in quickly!" Just as Yang Xiu was thinking, a voice sounded in his mind, and then under Yang Xiu's surprised gaze, his body moved involuntarily, which made him panic. As his body moved the torches around the cave,Lights came on one after another, illuminating the situation inside the cave. Finally, Yang Xiu stopped in front of a stone wall. On the stone wall, there were inscriptions that Yang Xiu could not understand.
"Boom!" A sound sounded from behind Yang Xiu. Yang Xiu turned around and found that the way forward had been blocked by another stone wall. Then Yang Xiu realized that he could control his body and secretly breathed a sigh of relief. It was really unsettling to be controlled by his body inexplicably.
"It looks like a decrypted secret room!" Yang Xiu muttered, looking around the cave and finally his eyes fell on the stone wall again, but this time Yang Xiu was surprised. He could actually read the words that he couldn't understand just now. It was not that he could understand the original words, but that the words themselves became words that he could understand.
I saw written on the stone wall, "Congratulations, young man! The fact that you have come here means that you have passed the first two levels. How do you feel about it? You are only the last step away from reaching the top! Enlightenment!"
When Yang Xiu read the last word, the words on the stone wall turned into light, condensed in front of Yang Xiu, and finally turned into a purple orb. Yang Xiu stretched out his hand to grab a huge energy coming from it. Yang Xiu concentrated on using his spiritual sense to feel the orb. When his spiritual sense touched the orb, Yang Xiu quickly withdrew his spiritual sense. According to the feedback from the spiritual sense exploration just now, it was a space orb. Yang Xiu couldn't help but be shocked.
In addition to the legend of spiritual treasures, there is another kind of elemental monks who master the power of elements in the Infinite Continent. Although these monks are not as famous as the monks who condense spiritual treasures, in terms of strength, the strength of the elemental monks is not comparable to that of ordinary monks.
Generally speaking, the aura of the elemental monks is relatively close to a certain element, which also allows the elemental monks to practice faster in the elemental land with which they are familiar. On the other hand, if the elemental monks have too strong control over a certain element, they can use a field to change the battlefield. In the field created by themselves, the elemental monks will not only have a greatly increased attack power, but also double the speed of aura recovery. This is why elemental monks are stronger than ordinary monks.

"Does this require me to comprehend the power of space?" Yang Xiu swallowed, looking at the space orb in his hand blankly and lost in thought. If this orb was for swordsmanship or something, he might have confidence. But this is an elemental orb and it is also a rare elemental orb of space. He didn't think he had this strength, but what Shibi said just now made him feel that it would be difficult for him to get out if he couldn't realize it. Yang Xiu looked at the orb and fell into thinking.
"Bang!" While Yang Xiu was thinking, Yang Xiu's spiritual treasure came out of the consciousness space. Under Yang Xiu's stunned gaze, the spiritual treasure that looked like a green jade sword pierced the orb in Yang Xiu's hand. Suddenly, the spatial spiritual energy in the orb leaked out, and the surrounding space began to shake and twist.
"Bang!" When Yang Xiu was observing the surroundings, the space orb in Yang Xiu's hand completely shattered, and the space around Yang Xiu gradually stabilized. The original cave disappeared, and everything was gray. Yang Xiu looked down and saw that his feet were also gray, as if he was stepping on clouds high in the sky.
"Buzz!" The Lingbao floated in front of Yang Xiu. Yang Xiu looked at the Lingbao. The original green jade sword embryo had now changed color from cyan to a blend of blue and purple.
"Is this the absorption of space spiritual energy?" Yang Xiu looked at the Lingbao in confusion. The Lingbao itself is the condensed spiritual energy in the Dantian. Since condensing the Lingbao, the place where the spiritual energy is stored has changed from being stored in the Dantian to being stored in the Lingbao. It can be said that the Lingbao is now his Dantian.
"Can we use the power of space?" Yang Xiu thought, reaching out to grab a piece of Lingbao and extracting spiritual energy from it. Sure enough, a stream of spatial spiritual energy was drawn out from it and condensed in Yang Xiu's hand. With his thoughts, the spatial spiritual energy was consumed by a tinyA rift in space appeared, but it only lasted for less than a second before disappearing. Yang Xiu was overjoyed that he could actually use the power of space.
"Is this also one of the characteristics of the Lingbao that can absorb the power of elements? Then such a Lingbao is really powerful!" Yang Xiu was still thinking, when a space crack appeared from behind him and a sword energy slashed out.
